Meet the Founder
Kirsten
Reed
Founder · Kora James & Co.

I started Kora James & Co. because I couldn't find a baby skincare product I actually trusted. I kept flipping bottles over, reading ingredients I couldn't pronounce, and wondering why "gentle" was just a marketing word.

So I decided to build something different — something I would actually put on my own baby's skin. And yours.
